title: .hathi.yml
description: hathi's settings for a repo: each Check on with true, off with false, or its settings. A Check without its key is on with its defaults.

conventional-commits.description: commit-msg: the message is a Conventional Commit, as commitlint's config-conventional reads it; its settings instead of true.

types.description: The types a subject may have, or any. config-conventional's 11 without it.

scopes.description: The scopes a subject may have, or any, as commitlint's scope-enum matches them; a subject without a scope passes either way. any without it.

max-length.description: The longest line, in characters; 0 for no limit. 100 without it.

pr-title.description: Whether hathi check ci checks a pull request's title too: on where the repo allows squash merges. false without it.

no-ai-coauthor.description: commit-msg: no AI as a commit's co-author, and no line crediting one; a person's Co-authored-by passes.

no-secrets-in-commits.description: pre-commit: the changes add no Secret and no Env file; hathi:allow-secret marks a false alarm.

no-conflict-markers.description: pre-commit: the changes add no conflict marker; a longer conflict-marker-size in .gitattributes lets a file hold them.

no-large-files.description: pre-commit: the changes add no file over max-size; a file already committed passes. Its settings instead of true.

max-size.description: The largest file a commit may add, in KB of 1024 bytes. 1024 without it.

linear-history.description: pre-push: the push sends no merge commit.
